title: Captain Accursio “Gus” Sanfilippo Young Fishermen's Development Act
official_title: To reauthorize the Young Fishermen's Development Act.
likelihoodReason: Introduced by Rep. Moulton (D-MA) with 8 cosponsors from both parties; passed the House. As a straightforward reauthorization of an existing, modestly funded program, it faces little organized opposition, though it still needs Senate floor time.
summary: Extends the funding authorization for the Young Fishermen's Development program — a Sea Grant marine program — for five more years, through fiscal year 2031.
brief: Reauthorizes the Young Fishermen's Development program's funding through fiscal year 2031.

top_lines.headline: Young Fishermen's Development Program
subs: A Sea Grant marine program under federal law
$2M per year authorized through fiscal year 2026

top_lines.headline: What This Bill Changes
subs: Extends the funding authorization through fiscal year 2031
Strikes '2026' and inserts '2031' in the program's funding section

sections.label: Section 1 — Young Fishermen's Development Act Reauthorization

items.main: Extends the Young Fishermen's Development program's funding authorization from fiscal year 2026 through fiscal year 2031.
items.detail: Amends Section 5(a) of the Young Fishermen's Development Act (33 U.S.C. 1144(a)) by striking '2026' and inserting '2031.' Current law authorizes $2M per year for the program; the bill extends that authorization period by five years without changing the amount.

gaps: The bill extends the program's funding authorization but does not change the $2M annual amount or the program's activities.
It reauthorizes appropriations through fiscal year 2031 but does not itself appropriate any funds.

featured_quotes.name: Mr. Moulton
featured_quotes.text: as the Representative of Gloucester, Massachusetts, America's oldest seaport, I am proud to lead this critical bill to reauthorize the Young Fishermen's Development Grant Program for another 5 years. This national competitive grant program supports the training and education of the Nation's next generation of commercial fishermen. Commercial fishing is at the heart of Massachusetts's identity and economy, but this legacy will not endure if we don't help the next generation get started. These grants help the industry expand and evolve.

modified: Young Fishermen's Development Act funding authorization extended from fiscal year 2026 to fiscal year 2031

added: Added a short title naming the Act the "Captain Accursio ``Gus'' Sanfilippo Young Fishermen's Development Act"
